export_controls.text: Semiconductor materials manufactured in low-Earth orbit will be a critical component of the next-generation semiconductor chips that will power U.S. leadership in AI, quantum computing and advanced defense systems. [...] It will strengthen Florida's position as a national leader in the space economy and keep America ahead of China in the race for technological and space dominance.

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses orbital semiconductor materials and US-China leadership, not export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: It contains no reference to restricting or enforcing overseas access to AI technology.
